engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
technicalNotes:
At the present time the Component Protection can only be learned/disabled using the Factory Tool in Combination with an online Connection. Every Audi Dealer/Service should be able to Gerçekleştirin: this Procedure.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Address [4F] - Central Electronics II  in the 2005-2006 (4F) Audi A6 and 2007 (4L) Q7 models from the   NAR (North American Region) market Kontrol edin: TSB 97-09-01 or TPI 2020254/1.
